name: local-code-agent
description: A locally installable code agent CLI with tool calling, guarded command execution, diagnostics-driven validation, and session resume.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js release:standalone
scripts.benchmark:smoke: tsx src/cli/index.ts benchmark --task project-structure-overview --task validation-loop --task tooling-and-ci --task code-agent-tooling-smoke --task interactive-cli-commands-smoke --task file-and-command-inspection-smoke --task agent-orchestration-smoke --task memory-smoke --task semantic-finder-smoke --task subtask-batch-smoke --task sandbox-patch-smoke --isolation-mode temp_copy --environment-soft-fail
scripts.benchmark:smoke:mock: tsx src/cli/index.ts benchmark --task project-structure-overview --task validation-loop --task tooling-and-ci --task code-agent-tooling-smoke --task interactive-cli-commands-smoke --task file-and-command-inspection-smoke --task agent-orchestration-smoke --task memory-smoke --task semantic-finder-smoke --task subtask-batch-smoke --task sandbox-patch-smoke --isolation-mode temp_copy --mock
scripts.pack:verify: node --input-type=module -e "import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; const output = execSync('npm pack --dry-run --json --silent', { encoding: 'utf8' }); const report = JSON.parse(output)[0]; const paths = report.files.map((file) => file.path); const forbidden = paths.filter((filePath) => /(^|\/)[^/]+\.test\.js$/.test(filePath)); if (!paths.includes('dist/cli/index.js')) { throw new Error('npm 包缺少 dist/cli/index.js'); } if (forbidden.length > 0) { throw new Error('npm 包包含测试产物: ' + forbidden.join(', ')); } console.log('Verified npm package contents (' + report.entryCount + ' files).');"
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run pack:verify
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
